scholarships.name: Mukhymantri Yuva Swavalamban Yojana (MYSY)
eligibility_criteria: Minimum 80 Percentile in 12th Board Exam
Have been admitted validly
The annual income should be lower than ₹. 6 lakh
scholarships.scholarship_amount: 50% of the tuition fee or ₹. 50000, whichever is lower.
process: Eligible student must register on the `https://mysy.guj.nic.in`
Upload the necessary documents and lock the application, and have it verified at the Help Centre as per MYSY

scholarships.name: Hon. Chief Minister Scholarship Scheme (CMSS)
eligibility_criteria: Must have passed 10+2 examination from Gujrat Board.
Family income should be less than ₹. 6 lakhs per Annum.
Only Applicable for Undergraduate Students.
scholarships.scholarship_amount: 50% of the tuition fee or ₹. 50000, whichever is lower.
process: Eligible student must register on the `https://scholarships.gujarat.gov.in/`
upload the necessary documents and lock the application, and have it verified at the Help Centre as per CMSS

scholarships.name: PRAGATI Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students
eligibility_criteria: Two Girls Child per family are eligible.
Family income should be less than ₹. 8 lakhs per Annum.
Students Admitted for in first year Diploma/Undergraduate Degree Level
process: The candidates should have been admitted to 1st year of the Degree in any of the AICTE approved institute during the current Academic Year through centralized admission process of the State/ Centre Government

eligibility_criteria: The student must belong to the SC caste
Must have a valid free-ship card issued by the department
A minimum of 50% in the previous exam is required
Annual Income must be below ₹. 2.50 lacs
process: Eligible Students must register on the Digital Gujarat website, upload the necessary documents, lock the application, and submit the hard copy at Institute
